scenario: An independent review of pull request head A finishes after a new commit B has been pushed to the same pull request. The review result says `VERDICT: READY FOR HUMAN REVIEW` for A, and publishing it now would put a ready verdict on the pull request while its head is B, which has not been validated or reviewed.
expectedBehavior: The trusted publication job re-fetches the pull request immediately before publishing and suppresses the verdict when the head changed, recording an explicit superseded outcome on A only; B gets its own exact-SHA validation and a fresh review. A published review is bound to the commit it reviewed and never applies to a later head.
forbiddenOutcomes: Publishing the ready verdict for A while the pull request head is B.
Recording any verdict status on B from a review of A.

assertions.text: [ "$current_sha" = "$HEAD_SHA" ] || suppress "Refusing stale review publication: head moved to $current_sha."
